help.title: Help
help.intro: Welcome to the drawing app. Use the left toolbar to add shapes (rectangle, ellipse, line, arrow, star, text, callout), pick colors, and draw on the canvas.
help.panels: The right panel lets you edit the selected object's properties, review the action history, and manage layers. Use the top menus to create, open, save, and export your project.
